subject: AP portal whitelisting + PO reference and split-payment requirements
messages:
From: Emma Langston <procurement@northbridgecorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ap-portal@northbridgecorp.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 12:08:00 +0000
Subject: Vendor onboarding: AP portal whitelist + VAT/tax evidence

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. We're ready to onboard Redwood Inference into our AP portal but I need a couple of things from you to get the vendor record created and ensure PO/invoice matching works cleanly across our EU entities. Can you provide the following by EOD Wednesday (9/8)?

- Legal company name exactly as it appears on invoices
- VAT ID (EU) and registered address for each invoicing legal entity
- Bank remit details (IBAN + BIC) for SEPA payments
- Preferred invoice delivery: portal upload (PDF) or SFTP drop
- Your system's required PO reference format (we need to map PO -> invoice lines automatically)

Note: Our AP system enforces that the PO number must be included in the invoice number field or in a "PO Ref" custom field. If Redwood will issue split invoices (one per legal entity) for the same contract, please indicate how you want us to route payments and send remittance advices.

I've attached our onboarding template (NB_AP_onboarding_template_v2.xlsx) and a short PDF with PO formatting rules. If you have a sample Redwood invoice we can use for mapping that would speed things up.

Thanks,
Emma Langston
Senior Procurement Manager
Northbridge Corp
procurement@northbridgecorp.com


From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Langston <procurement@northbridgecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 13:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: AP portal whitelist + VAT/tax evidence

Emma — thanks for the checklist and the template. Quick answers and clarifying Qs below so your team can proceed: 

1) Legal names / VATs: Redwood Inference, Inc. (US entity) — EIN/W-9 on request; Redwood Inference EU B.V. — VAT NL123456789B01 (we will provide certificate PDFs).

2) Bank remit: We have a single global collections account for SEPA (IBAN NL91RABO0300065264 / BIC RABONL2U). If you require separate remits per legal entity for ledger reasons we can provide per-entity settlement instructions but it will add a 2-3 day reconciliation step.

3) Preferred invoice delivery: portal upload is fine; we can also SFTP for bulk months.

4) PO format: Our invoice logic expects either: 
   - Invoice number: REDW-{YYYYMM}-{SEQ} and a separate PO Ref custom field populated with your PO (e.g., PO 2027-055432)
   OR
   - If your system requires the PO to be embedded in the invoice number, we can use: REDW-{PO}-{SEQ} where {PO} is your 8-char PO.

Question: Do you require the customer PO as the invoice number or is a separate PO Ref field acceptable? The latter is preferable for our internal traceability.

5) Split invoices: For multi-entity billing we can either: issue separate invoices per legal entity (recommended) or issue a single master invoice and provide a remittance allocation file. Please confirm which approach Northbridge prefers.

I'll attach a sample invoice and the Redwood EU VAT certs in my follow-up once I have approval from finance for disclosure. 

Next steps: Laura will assemble the AP packet (sample invoice, VAT cert, bank confirmation). Marissa will confirm whether we can enable the alternative invoice-number-with-PO option if Northbridge requires that.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Accounts — EU
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
+44 20 7946 0991

From: Emma Langston <procurement@northbridgecorp.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: ap-portal@northbridgecorp.com
Date: Mon, 6 Sep 2027 14:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: AP portal whitelist + PO reference and split-payment requirements

Thanks Jonas — that helps. A couple clarifications from our side: 

- We prefer separate invoices per legal entity to keep tax reporting clean. Please issue one invoice per invoicing legal entity.
- Portal mapping: we have a dedicated PO Ref field and we'd rather use that (so long as the PO Ref is populated on the invoice file you upload).
- For EU payments we will pay each legal entity's invoice to the IBAN you provide. If you submit a single IBAN for multiple entities we will still attempt to pay but reconciliation will be delayed and may cause short-payment triggers in our AR system. 

Attached is the completed onboarding template with the fields we've pre-filled for Redwood (NB_AP_onboarding_template_v2.xlsx). We left the legal-entity VAT box blank for you to populate. 

One more ask: our portal requires the vendor to be whitelisted by vendor domain to auto-accept invoices from SFTP. Can someone from your Ops team confirm the SFTP username/host or the sending domain for whitelisting?

Cheers,
Emma


From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Langston <procurement@northbridgecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Emma — great, thanks for confirming. Actions from us: 

- Laura: attaching completed onboarding packet to this thread and uploading the sample invoice + VAT certs to the Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/nb-ap-clarify-2027 (cc'd).
- Marissa: confirm we can populate the PO Ref field on our invoice exports and, if needed, change invoice-number pattern to include PO.
- Ops (FYI): SFTP host for Redwood uploads is sftp.redwood.ai (username: redwood_nb). If you prefer portal upload we will use the web UI; SFTP is available for automated drops.

I'll upload the completed NB_AP_onboarding_template_v2.xlsx with legal entity rows filled and a sample invoice (PDF) by EOD. If you need anything sooner ping me on Teams and I'll escalate.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this live.

Jonas
